description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for testing the TerminationReasonConfigurationDao within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin. It includes setup, CRUD operation tests, and validation methods for termination reason entities.

classes.name: TerminationReasonConfigurationDaoTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing CRUD and validation methods of TerminationReasonConfigurationDao.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the DAO object and populates test data from fixture before each test.

methods.name: testAddTerminationReason
methods.description: Tests adding a new termination reason and verifies it was saved correctly.

methods.name: testEditTerminationReason
methods.description: Tests updating an existing termination reason and verifies the change.

methods.name: testGetTerminationReasonById
methods.description: Retrieves a termination reason by ID and checks its properties.

methods.name: testGetTerminationReasonList
methods.description: Fetches a list of termination reasons and verifies count and types.

methods.name: testDeleteTerminationReasons
methods.description: Deletes multiple termination reasons and checks the deletion count.

methods.name: testDeleteWrongRecord
methods.description: Attempts to delete a non-existing record and expects zero deletions.

methods.name: testIsExistingTerminationReasonName
methods.description: Checks if various case-insensitive and whitespace-trimmed names are recognized as existing.

methods.name: testReasonsInUse
methods.description: Checks IDs of termination reasons currently in use.

methods.name: testGetTerminationReasonByName
methods.description: Retrieves termination reasons by name with different case and whitespace variations, and verifies the correct ID is returned or null if not found.
